تحتفون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفُونَ (taḥtafūna) /taħ.ta.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# تُحْتَفَوْنَ (tuḥtafawna) /tuħ.ta.faw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
